title: Fen bank grass
subject: Subject: the damp grass of a fen bank, about 3 m across, seen from above. Dark green and blue-green grass with clover, small muddy dark gaps, and a sparse even scatter of tiny pale flowers. Cold misty night colours with a little lavender in the light, but the texture itself evenly lit.
use: The grassy banks round Bogmire's water in the fight.

title: Reeds with feathery plumes
subject: Subject: one clump of tall marsh reeds and rushes, about 1 m across and 1.8 m high: long dark green-grey leaves arching outwards and several stems topped with pale silvery-lavender feathery plumes. Cold night colours.
use: Along the edges of the water round the Bogmire fight, many clumps side by side.

title: Weeping willow
subject: Subject: one old weeping willow, whole, about 10 m high: a leaning dark trunk, branches arching over and long hanging curtains of thin dark green-grey leaves reaching almost to the ground, a few strands of hanging moss. Cold misty night colours.
use: Round the edges of the fen in the Bogmire fight.

title: Drowned dead stump
subject: Subject: one dead drowned tree stump, whole, about 3 m high, its top broken into a jagged point, grey-black weathered wood with splits, a few short broken branch stubs, its foot flaring into roots (the part that stands in water). Cold night colours.
use: Standing in the black water round the Bogmire fight, a few of them.

title: Bogmire's stilt hall and tower
subject: Subject: a tall old timber hall on stilts over a fen, seen flat from the front: dark weathered plank walls, steep stacked gables with dark shingle roofs, several small warm amber windows, a covered porch, and beside it a tall open timber lookout tower with a little roof. The stilts at the bottom stop where the water would be. About 25 m across.
use: A far backdrop piece across the water in the Bogmire fight (and a model guide for its houses).
